http/internal/http2_settings#

The SETTINGS a peer advertised, applied one by one (RFC 9113 §6.5).

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The SETTINGS a peer advertised, applied one by one (RFC 9113 §6.5).

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

object Http2PeerSettings#

object Http2PeerSettings

Peer advertisements are observations, not local allocation requests.

Http2PeerSettings.Http2PeerSettings#

Http2PeerSettings()

The initial values: a 4096-byte table, a 65535-byte window, 16384-byte frames, no stream or header-list limit, push enabled.

The header table size.

Http2PeerSettings.setting#

setting(identifier is int, value is int, from_server is bool) is ^Http2PeerSettings
